questions.text: What does the 'Japa' syndrome refer to in the novel?
options: The migration of Nigerians abroad for better opportunities
questions.explanation: 'Japa' refers to the mass emigration of skilled Nigerians to foreign countries for better economic opportunities.

questions.text: How does Mr. Bepo feel about the academic performance of his students?
options: Proud and motivated to improve them
Frustrated and ready to give up
questions.explanation: Mr. Bepo takes great pride in his students' achievements and is always motivated to help them improve.
